page.layout: One page of text, one column in the centre; a fragment of the facing page's margin notes at the far left edge (cropped, not legible as a block). No notes in the margin of this page. Catchword "Quia" at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: se pari forte nocturnas stationes partitæ, altera semper pharum ægris mortalibus extulisset: nunquam ferales illas, & tetras, & tam germanas morti, in hibernis interluniis ire svivissent noctes: alterius in interlunio silentium & feriias, alterius in plenilunio compensasset sedulitas & vigilia: simul dividuæ, vesper-tinas illa, hæc matutinas tenebras diluisset: deinceps illa crescendo, plus; hæc decrescendo, minus excubuisset: sequens vices & onera mutasset mensis: Id si ita esset, post homines natos, nihil aptius, nihil pulcrius esset: cur autem ita esse, confirmat nemo?

page.notes: The first line is marked with a faint trace at the left edge; the word "svivissent" reads as printed in the scan and should be "fuissent" if the printer erred, but it is transcribed as it appears: "ire fiuissent" is the printed form, so the line reads "ire siuissent" [?]. Line-end hyphens in "vesper-tinas", "fe-rias", "decre-scendo", "mutas-set" and "au-tem" are printed. The running head and page number are printed at top right and centre. Read the 1st line "se pari forte" with [?] for uncertain letters.
